buys $1.5B in stock and demands
massive share buybacks.

THE INFECTION (April 2014)
New Corporate Debt: $12 Billion
THE MECHANISM: INTEREST-RATE ARBITRAGE
The strategy relies on borrowing at 3% to buy equity yielding
10%. By replacing equity with debt, the stock price is
artificially inflated for short-term extraction.
THE RESULT: TANGIBLE SACRIFICE
Despite holding $150B in cash in 2014, Apple borrows $12B
purely to buy back its own stock. Tangible industrial
investment is sacrificed to feed financial engineering.
